description.from:
Launch Shipped (shipped.anth.us): a community-ranked feed of AI that actually shipped. It pilots Papyrus collaborative steering (PPY-77bb3b) and the public knowledge base (PPY-428252).
Status 2026-10-21:
- Design scaffold is live with every page.
- 51 real items (30 decision models, 21 open TTS) are published with topic pages.
- Agent-readable pages are live.
- Prospectus registration is done.
- Reader sign-in is waiting on Papyrus cms.siteOrigin, Prospectus siteSubject and Ryan's Google redirect URIs.
- Votes, ratings and karma are being built.
Delivery rule: deploy incrementally, keep the full design visible, and dim placeholders (~60% plus a label) until they are real.

Launch Shipped (shipped.anth.us): a community-ranked feed of AI that actually shipped. It pilots Papyrus collaborative steering (PPY-77bb3b) and the public knowledge base (PPY-428252, closed).

Status 2026-10-22 (10:45Z):
- Live and checked: 70 real items (40 open weights, 30 decisions in the wild) with topic pages; Papyrus 5.22.0 pinned.
- Knowledge base live: 282-page wiki stamped Edited by AI, Trending strip and list, Emerging clusters, concept of the week, topic count (All 282 topics), entity chips.
- Agent-readable pages live: Markus twins, bare .md, Accept negotiation, llms.txt and llms-full.txt.
- Site chrome: lime chrome, generic footer, wide layout (PR #26), newsletter signup at /roundup/ (simulator-verified).
- Reader steering is enabled (PR #39, deploy run 39761870423 success): sign-in control, Vote, UsedIt, Rating, Comments and Submit islands render; snapshot JSON under /_data/reader/ is live but empty.
- Blocked on Ryan: Google redirect URIs for papyrus-shipped-cms (ship-63b07d), which gates the first sign-in, vote, rating, comment and submission (ship-b3b934, ship-378fcc, ship-d02e82); and the newsletter confirmation retest (ship-7e99a6) after the email lead fixes the confirm page.
- Open: PR #38 (poll secret in site.json), live-number schedule check (ship-0efe84), Person ID scan as a Shipped gate (ship-b3933d), score combination (ship-1f3d29), designer adjustments (ship-14efe5).
- Decisions in force: no WAF; snapshot four times a day; the AI does the accepting and naming and is labelled AI; the word desk is not used on pages; the Data Parade mission and policy are saved.
Delivery rule: deploy incrementally, keep the full design visible, and dim placeholders (~60% plus a label) until they are real.
